projects.name: shotcut-mcp
projects.description: MCP server that edits video through Shotcut's engine, MLT, with no GUI. An agent can create a project, add and trim clips, split, move and remove them, apply filters, add titles and crossfades, read the timeline back and render it with melt. The output is a native Shotcut .mlt project that can be opened and edited by hand in Shotcut.
